page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 62 GB of system memory. The instance integrates a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture, providing 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage solutions, while network connectivity is rated at a baseline of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear division between CPU and GPU capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is weak, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth fall into the average tier. However, the integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong parallel processing capabilities, achieving top-tier results in LLM inference prompt processing for both small and medium models, alongside strong text generation performance for 7B parameter models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads without the premium associated with higher-end accelerator models. The lack of local storage and weak single-core CPU performance represent notable tradeoffs. This instance is best suited for workloads such as low-to-medium density deep learning inference, small-scale LLM prompt processing, video transcoding, and GPU-accelerated database queries.
